description: FFmpeg 7.1 LTS line - one of 4 tiers from the ffmpegkit-maintained FFmpegKit fork (Free-71/Basic-71/Full-71/Full GPL-71) - this is FREE: VP8/VP9 + AV1 encode/decode (libvpx, libaom, dav1d), Opus/Vorbis/Speex audio, software-only. Coexists with the separate 6.0 LTS line (dev.ffmpegkit-maintained:ffmpeg-kit-free) - distinct artifact, does not replace it. Need H.264/H.265 encode, hardware codec access, TLS, images, OCR, subtitles or SRT? See the Basic-71/Full-71/Full GPL-71 tiers via the Project URL link below.
